overview_description.description:
NexGenT is an Online IT Academy that provides "Military Grade" Training for the next generation workforce. It solves the growing shortage of IT engineers for enterprise companies. They create job-ready professionals in just 22 weeks while minimizing costs for recruitment and ongoing training needs by leveraging their cloud education and career management platform. They help students go from "Zero To Engineer" in just 6 months.

The company was founded in 2016 and is based in San Jose, California.
